ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

ParallaxImage.helper: Choose the image or file to use for parallax image. Use a clear file that fits this content.

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Description.helper: Enter the formatted content for description. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

Price.helper: Enter the price to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ActionButtonText.helper: Enter the action button text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

MostPopular.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control most popular.

ShowPopularRibbon.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control show popular ribbon.

FeatureDescriptionText.helper: Enter the formatted content for feature description text. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

Features.helper: Add and arrange the items used for features. Remove any item you do not need.

Items.helper: Add and arrange the items used for items. Remove any item you do not need.
